name: Dr. Samuel Schmidt
role: Co-Founder, CFO, Product Lead and Data Scientist, Vaionex Corporation
profile: Biochemist and Co-Founder, CFO, Product Lead and Data Scientist of Vaionex Corporation, an AI and blockchain development and data science company. Scientific background in glycobiology, cell-penetrating peptides, bioorthogonal labeling and advanced microscopy; recent data-science work re-analyses published functional-genomics data on noncanonical open reading frames and microproteins.
